prompt: Write a Playwright E2E test that covers sign-up → login → edit profile → logout. Must not be flaky, must run in ≤ 10 s locally.
rubric: 5/5 if: the test uses stable selectors (data-testid, not text), seeds the DB deterministically, asserts on API responses (not just UI), cleans up after itself, and is tagged so CI can exclude it in the fast lane.
